title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Propulsion System Network Engineer to be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and overall management of propulsion system communication files (CAN, LDF). This role will be critical in supporting root cause analysis, problem resolution, and the administration of our Propulsion Networking Process.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain propulsion system communication files (CAN, LDF) in accordance with project requirements.
  • Support root cause analysis and problem resolution related to propulsion network communication.
  • Administer and improve the Propulsion Networking Process.
  • Manage document releases, ensuring alignment with project milestones.
  • Ensure conformity and quality in file generation processes.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering counterparts, including Chief Engineers, COE Leads, and System Engineers.
  • Work with the Simulation team to integrate network data into simulation environments.
  • Interface and coordinate with Electrical Engineering (EE) Networking teams across all regions regarding production and prototype CAN/LIN file development.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Applied Physics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or related Engineering field from an ABET accredited university
  • Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience with Controller Area Network (CAN)/LIN communication systems development and standards
  • Experience with Propulsion System communication architectures and controllers
  • Working experience with Microsoft Excel, Word, Notepad ++ and PowerPoint
  • Highly motivated/self-starter with proven leadership skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment
  • Trained in the Agile Methodology
  • Strong verbal/written communication skills
  • Good understanding of CAN/LIN interfaces


Technical Tool Skills:

  • MATLAB/SIMULINK/STATEFLOW
  • Vector CANalyzer, CANoe
  • IBM Rational DOORS
  • Decent knowledge of CAN/LIN

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.

title: KYC - brazil
description:
Responsibilities:

Conduct international verification case reviews, including individual and corporate verifications.

Review and confirm the results of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and economic sanctions blacklist screenings.

Coordinate with other departments on KYC/CDD-related workflows and process daily applications.

Assist in optimizing the global customer KYC/CDD process.

Analyze KYC vendor review situations and seek better solutions.

Assist in monitoring the daily status of KYC/CDD and check the system's operation.

Conduct research on the KYC/CDD regulatory requirements and documentation for different countries and complete the research report.

Assist in the implementation of AML policies and other policies involving KYC/CDD.

Responsible for dealing with difficult KYC problems related to Turkish, or Spanish, or Arabic if applicable.

Support the Team Leader in completing other related tasks.

Position Requirements:

A bachelor's degree or higher in finance, law, economics, auditing, languages or related fields from a full-time university program (preference for graduates from internationally renowned universities). Proficiency in Mandarin is preferred.

At least two years of experience in KYC/CDD or other compliance-related roles within banks, securities, or other financial institutions is preferred.

Proficiency in English, with the ability to use English as a working language.

Master at least one language in Turkish, Arabic, Urdu, and have passed TEM-8, or possess an equivalent level of language proficiency, will be given priority consideration.

Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering and international economic sanctions theories; CAMS certification is a plus.

A stable personality with a strong sense of compliance and responsibility, strong learning and stress tolerance abilities, good communication skills, meticulous work, high enthusiasm, and a sense of responsibility.

Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in using office software such as Excel, Word, PPT.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: ABAP Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD


We are looking for a skilled ABAP Cloud Clean Core Developer to join our SAP team and support digital transformation initiatives in the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector.


The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in ABAP Cloud and RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model), with a solid understanding of Clean Core principles and the strict compliance standards that govern pharmaceutical operations. This role will involve building upgrade-safe, cloud-ready SAP solutions while ensuring regulatory compliance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain upgrade-safe, extensible solutions in SAP S/4HANA Cloud following Clean Core principles.
  • Use ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) to build modern, cloud-ready applications.
  • Ensure all developments are designed and documented in line with pharmaceutical compliance standards (GxP, CFR Part 11, validation protocols).
  • Collaborate with functional, quality, and compliance teams to deliver solutions that are both technically sound and audit-ready.
  • Develop APIs, CDS views, OData services, and integration scenarios that support regulated business processes.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA transformation projects within manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and regulatory domains.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and validation activities to ensure alignment with IT and QA requirements.
  • Stay current with SAP BTP extensibility, Clean Core roadmap, and pharma industry digital trends.


Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as an ABAP Developer, with strong expertise in ABAP Cloud and RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model).
  • Solid understanding of Clean Core principles and experience implementing upgrade-safe, extensible solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical compliance standards, including GxP, CFR Part 11, and validation protocols.
  • Experience developing APIs, CDS views, and OData services, as well as supporting complex integration scenarios.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams, including quality and compliance groups.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and regulatory domains in the pharma or life sciences industry is a strong plus.
  • Up-to-date understanding of SAP BTP extensibility and emerging trends in pharma industry digital transformation.


Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience working in pharma, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Knowledge of Fiori/UI5 development and integration.
  • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) or cloud-based integrations.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and tools for SAP development lifecycle.


Benefits:

  • The opportunity to contribute to a global leader in supply chain innovation and digital transformation.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Software Engineer SR
description:
E aí, tudo azul por aí?


A Turbi é a locadora do futuro: 100% digital, movida a tecnologia, gente boa e paixão por transformar a forma como as pessoas se locomovem. A gente abre carro pelo app (sim, sem chave!) e acredita que inovação de verdade começa com um time engajado e com liberdade pra criar.


Estamos procurando uma pessoa para a posição de Software Engineer - SR, alguém que queira acelerar com a gente nessa jornada.


O seu papel por aqui:


Como Software Engineer, você vai ter um papel chave em auxiliar o time a repensar a estrutura dos nossos produtos, melhorar a eficiência reduzindo custo e gerar novas oportunidades de negócios.


Nosso objetivo para o ano é repensar a estrutura dos nossos produtos, aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e criar novas oportunidades de negócio


Mais do que entregar tarefas, a ideia é construir junto com autonomia, responsabilidade e espaço pra testar, errar e aprender.


O que você vai encarar no dia a dia:


  • Participar de discussões sobre o direcionamento técnico da squad.
  • Auxiliar engenheiros e engenheiras de menor senioridade do time.
  • Codar soluções complexas quando necessário.
  • Trazer visão de mercado e melhores práticas de engenharia.
  • Pensar em soluções simples e otimizadas.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend, com serviços de alta performance (preferencialmente em go e typescript).
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvedor em kubernetes (Criar e deployar aplicações compliant com twelve factor).
  • Conhecimentos em git/gitflow para releases atômicas, escaláveis e reversíveis.
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos.
  • Experiência em evangelizar e implementar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.
  • Experiência resolvendo problemas em produção, empregando contramedidas conforme necessário, bem como atuando em soluções definitivas de longo prazo.
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração.


O que a Turbi oferece pra te apoiar nessa jornada?


  • Salário competitivo no modelo PJ, alinhado com o mercado;
  • Saúde em dia: plano de saúde SulAmérica pra cuidar de você.
  • Sorriso garantido: plano odontológico Bradesco.
  • Corpo em movimento: acesso ao Gympass pra treinar do seu jeito.
  • TurbiFree todo mês: R$ 1.000 pra usar nossos carros como quiser.
  • Pausa merecida: 30 dias de recesso remunerado depois de 12 meses com a gente.
  • Parabéns com folga: Day Off no seu aniversário pra comemorar como quiser.
  • Licença maternidade estendida: mais tempo pra viver esse momento com tranquilidade.
  • Licença paternidade: presença garantida nos primeiros dias mais importantes.
  • Bônus: Atrelado ao atingimento de metas da Turbi e individuais.


Nosso jeito de trabalhar:


A Turbi é feita por gente real, que erra, aprende, cresce e faz acontecer. Por aqui, autonomia anda junto com responsabilidade. A gente valoriza um ambiente seguro pra falar o que pensa, construir com liberdade e ter conversas difíceis com respeito.


A gente valoriza pessoas que aprendem, se desafiam e querem gerar impacto de verdade.


Se viu aqui? Então se inscreve e vem com a gente transformar a mobilidade urbana!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend – Golang
description:
A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!

Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com sólida experiência em Golang, para atuar em soluções de alta escalabilidade, resiliência e performance. O(a) profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de microsserviços, práticas de DevOps, integração contínua e observabilidade, em um ambiente moderno baseado em Kubernetes e arquiteturas cloud-native.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e microsserviços em Golang, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura (MVC, Hexagonal, Clean Code) e realizando code reviews.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, testes unitários e de integração, além de atuar com CI/CD e práticas DevOps.
  • Realizar deploys e troubleshooting em Kubernetes (pods, serviços, rollouts), utilizando K9s, Splunk e Datadog para observabilidade.
  • Trabalhar com clusters gerenciados (EKS/AKS) e manifests YAML para configuração e versionamento.
  • Criar e manter Helm Charts para automação de deploys e gestão de configurações por ambiente.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência sólida com Golang no desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo deploy, troubleshooting e rollouts.

title: Operations & Executive Support Specialist
description:
Operations & Executive Support Specialist – Anvilgrid Energy Solutions (Remote)


The Vision

At Anvilgrid Energy Solutions , we’re building the future of clean energy through commercial and industrial battery backup systems and microgrids that empower businesses to operate sustainably and independently.


We’re a new cleantech company spun up by industry experts , hitting the ground running with major deployments in sight. Our mission is simple: build something big—and do it right.


Who We’re Looking For

You’re proactive, organized, and thrive on creating systems that keep things running smoothly. You know how to anticipate needs, take ownership, and execute with precision. You enjoy translating ideas into structured plans, ensuring that the details are handled so leadership can focus on strategy and growth.


You’ll excel in this role if you:

  • Have a strong sense of initiative and can identify what needs to be done without waiting for direction.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently across teams and time zones.
  • Stay calm under pressure, follow through consistently, and take pride in your work.
  • Are motivated by helping build something big from the ground up.

    • Why You Should Join Us
    • Be part of an early-stage cleantech company shaping how energy resilience is delivered to commercial and industrial clients.
    • Work directly with a visionary founder and seasoned industry team.
    • Gain exposure to renewable energy, microgrids, and sustainable tech while helping build foundational systems from the ground up.
    • Join a culture that values professionalism, promptness, and proactivity , and where we win when our customers win.


    Role Responsibilities

    You’ll act as the founder’s operational partner, ensuring focus, organization, and follow-through across daily and weekly priorities.


    • Weekly & Daily Planning: Lead Monday check-ins to align priorities and manage task lists in Workflowy and Google Workspace. Prepare concise Friday summaries and ensure key items progress to completion.


    • Calendar & Coordination: Manage the founder’s schedule, logistics, and meeting flow through Google Calendar and Calendly. Coordinate client meetings, follow-ups, and travel arrangements with precision.


    • Meeting Prep & Research: Prepare “Whispers” (pre-meeting briefs) with relevant background, LinkedIn profiles, and context. Conduct research to support business development or decision-making, and distill long content (e.g., reports, podcasts) into actionable notes.


    • Communication Support: Draft professional correspondence, manage inbox triage, and ensure clear and timely responses based on voice memos or notes.


    • Operations & Documentation: Keep compliance, permit, and project documentation organized. Support customer visits, event logistics, and file management across Google Drive.


    • Process Improvement: Identify and implement ways to simplify, automate, or standardize recurring tasks. Help refine systems and build playbooks that strengthen daily operations.


    • General Support: Help with small personal and family tasks that come up for the CEO such as scheduling a doctor appointment and tracking personal meetings and follow ups.


    Skills & Experience
    • 3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or similar role supporting leadership or founders.
    • Exceptional organizational and follow-through skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
    • Proficiency in Google Workspace , PowerPoint , Calendly , and productivity tools (Workflowy, Notion, Asana, etc.).
    • Strong research and synthesis skills.
    • Bonus: experience with engineering drawings, compliance workflows, or the solar/battery industry .
    • Tech-savvy mindset, comfortable experimenting with tools and improving processes.

    • Our Values
    • We win when they win – Our clients’ success defines ours.
    • See it through – Follow-through is everything.
    • Make it right – We fix problems, not blame.
    • Build something big – We take pride in creating meaningful impact.
    • Transparency – Honest communication and accountability drive trust.


    Compensation & Employment Type

    Type: Independent contractor, Full-time (40 hours/week)

    Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST

    Location: Remote – candidates from Central/South America or Eastern Europe preferred

    Compensation: Starting at 1,500 USD/Month, depending on experience


    Application Process

    Please email the following to Maria+ Anvilgrid @allsikes.com:


    • Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf)
    • Cover letter, including: a) What intrigues you about working with us, b) Specific experiences that prove you're the right person for this role, c) The last books you've read, d) What you do for fun.
    • Short examples of when you’ve:
    • Turned messy inputs into clear task plans
    • Identified something that needed to be done, fixed, or improved, and took ownership to make it happen


    Well-structured, thoughtful applications will stand out. If you have questions about the role or responsibilities, feel free to include them in your message.

title: Assistente de Liderança Técnica
description:
Programa de Desenvolvimento: Assistente de Liderança Técnica (3 meses)


Estou abrindo 1 vaga para quem quer mergulhar de cabeça no universo real de gestão e tecnologia, e ter sua primeira oportunidade de atuar no ambiente que não vê no livro da faculdade.


O que torna isso diferente?

Você não vai ficar preso em uma área. Ao longo de 3 meses, vai ter contato com:

Arquitetura de software

Desenvolvimento (full stack)

Segurança cibernética (ofensiva e defensiva)

Controle de qualidade

Gerenciamento de stakeholders

Pensamento pragmático

E como tudo isso se conecta na prática


O formato:

Acompanhamento diário do dia a dia de liderança técnica

Mentoria semanal estruturada

Exposição a diferentes áreas e desafios reais

Aprendizado de gestão, priorização e tomada de decisão

Ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução


Oferecemos:

Bolsa-auxílio mensal (PJ/MEI)

Visão 360º de tecnologia em ambiente corporativo

Desenvolvimento acelerado em gestão e tech

Possibilidade real de efetivação após os 3 meses


Perfil ideal:

Estudante de TI (ADS, Ciência da Computação, Eng. Software ou similar)

title: Graphic Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


What we're looking for


We’re looking for a Graphic Designer who’s skilled in UX design, with a sharp eye for layout, consistency, and visual storytelling. If you're someone who can take a creative brief and turn it into sleek, conversion-friendly assets that speak to a SaaS audience — we want to hear from you.

You’ll collaborate with our design and content teams to create assets that live across websites, social, decks, and beyond.


What you'll do


  • Design branded visuals for SaaS startups (one-pagers, pitch decks, social ads, case studies, etc.)
  • Work on presentation design, marketing collateral, and internal brand materials
  • Apply consistent visual systems across different formats and platforms
  • Collaborate with Product Designers, Copywriters, and Founders to translate ideas into clean, strategic visuals
  • Create and refine brand identities when needed (logo, color, typography, etc.)
  • Support UI/Web design tasks with visual assets (icons, illustrations, mockups)
  • Deliver assets quickly, adapt based on feedback, and iterate fast
  • Requirements:Strong portfolio with examples of branding, marketing, and presentation work
  • Proficiency in Canva, Figma, Illustrator, or Photoshop
  • Experience designing for SaaS or B2B audiences
  • Understanding of modern design trends, visual hierarchy, and conversion principles
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with direct feedback loops
  • Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to have


  • Experience designing websites in Webflow or Framer
  • Experience with People Analytics and/or Business Intelligence
  • Animation skills (e.g., Lottie, After Effects)
  • Knowledge of performance design (A/B testing, CRO, etc.)
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and ad formats


Salary & Benefits


UP to USD $1,500/month (based on experience)

Fully remote — work from anywhere

Projects with high-growth SaaS startups

Buscamos profissionais com perfil hunter e experiência consultiva para expandir nosso núcleo de parceiros.


| Tributário | Previdenciário | Revisão Custos Folha de Pagamento | B2B |


Se você busca autonomia e resultados, o Grupo AG Capital oferece uma parceria estratégica para atuar com soluções tributárias que geram impacto direto no fluxo de caixa das empresas.


O que oferecemos:

•Flexibilidade : Atuação 100% remota, sem conflito com outras atividades. Contrato PJ | Início Imediato.


•Suporte Completo : Equipe técnica especializada, ferramentas tecnológicas e acompanhamento em todas as etapas do negócio.


•Tecnologia de Ponta : Nossa metodologia, pioneira como a primeira TaxTech do Brasil (15 anos de mercado), audita mais de 80 rubricas, revelando oportunidades que abordagens convencionais não alcançam.


•Segurança e Compliance : Comprovamos 15 anos sem revés, seguro contra erros e omissões, e garantia de CND em contrato.


•Remuneração: Modelo 100% comissionado, alinhado ao seu desempenho e ao valor gerado.

Ciclo de venda curto e repasse de comissão rápido.


Sua atuação:

•Identificação e captação de novas oportunidades de negócios.

•Desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas e gestão de carteira de clientes (Lucro Presumido e Real).

•Apresentação de soluções que otimizam a carga tributária e promovem compliance.


Se você busca uma parceria que valoriza sua expertise e oferece uma estrutura robusta para alavancar seus resultados, convidamos você a conhecer o Grupo AG Capital.

title: Tech Lead Frontend React/Next.js
description:
Vaga: Arquiteto(a) Frontend / Tech Lead React


Sobre o Projeto:


O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistemas legados , com foco em reestruturação do frontend, definição de padrões de UI/UX, performance e integração com APIs modernas.

O desafio envolve liderar tecnicamente as equipes de desenvolvimento, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas no ciclo de entrega.


Responsabilidades:

  • Definir padrões de UI/UX , design system e diretrizes de performance para o frontend.
  • Integrar aplicações frontend com backend e APIs (OpenAPI / AsyncAPI).
  • Apoiar e orientar desenvolvedores , realizando revisões de código e promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Assegurar a qualidade do código , cobertura de testes automatizados e aderência aos princípios de acessibilidade.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para múltiplas equipes, conduzindo decisões estratégicas de frontend.
  • Colaborar com áreas de arquitetura e backend para garantir consistência entre camadas e interfaces.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com React e Next.js .
  • Domínio de design responsivo e princípios modernos de UI/UX.
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (unitários e end-to-end).
  • Vivência com integração via OpenAPI/AsyncAPI .
  • Experiência em projetos de modernização de sistemas legados .


Desejável:

  • Atuação prévia como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto(a) Frontend .
  • Experiência atuando como referência técnica para múltiplas equipes.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD, observabilidade e monitoramento de performance frontend .

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js, AWS, PHP)
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: US Time

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Backend Focused) to design, develop, and scale backend systems and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, and AWS . You’ll collaborate across teams to ensure our platform is reliable, secure, and future-ready.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build scalable backend services and APIs.
  • Maintain and enhance system performance and security.
  • Integrate third-party systems and ensure seamless front-end interaction.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams.


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years in full stack or backend development.
  • Strong in Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP , and AWS/serverless .
  • Experience with relational + NoSQL databases .
  • Knowledge of microservices, Kubernetes , and security best practices.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with legacy systems, Agile, IaC tools, and React.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) environments.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Your role and responsibilities:


  • Ensure SLA adherence and process compliance (ITIL awareness)
  • Mentor and train team members
  • Handle tickets, perform root cause analysis, and troubleshoot technical issues
  • Lead installation, configuration, migration, and upgrade activities
  • Define and enforce operational processes
  • Maximize system uptime and manage BASIS activities
  • Collaborate with functional teams on cutover strategies and post-implementation support


Technical Expertise:


  • SAP server installation/configuration (ABAP, Java, ABAP+Java stacks)
  • High Availability setup (Unix/Windows)
  • SAP BASIS server administration and RCA for escalated issues
  • Kickstart environment setup and maintenance
  • End-to-end SAP lifecycle implementations for global clients
  • SAP version and EHP upgrades
  • Performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting across app, DB, and OS
  • Strong understanding of NetWeaver components (EP, PI, BI, ECC, CRM, SRM, SolMan, TREX, MDM)
  • Oracle DB, BRTools, SAP HANA DB, Sybase ASE, Linux/Windows admin
  • Advanced English


Soft Skills:


  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Strong documentation and MS Office skills (Project, Visio)
  • Customer-centric mindset with high adaptability
  • Ability to manage unforeseen situations and drive value


Additional Experience:


  • Production systems and data center operations
  • Server migration, patching, and upgrade experience


Certifications Preferred:


SAP BASIS, NetWeaver, Solution Manager, OS/DB Migration


Please submit resumé in English.

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect

title: Direct Response Web Designer – Shopify & Landing Page Specialist (Hourly, As-Needed)
description:
Company Overview:

Natura Labs is a fast-paced, results-oriented creative and performance marketing team working with multiple e-commerce and direct-to-consumer brands. We specialize in high-performing ads, conversion-focused web pages, and creative strategies that scale.


We’re hiring an experienced Direct Response Web Designer to support our ongoing projects, focusing on landing pages, branded UI/UX assets, and e-commerce sites across any major platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, Webflow, custom, etc.). This role is ideal for someone with a strong eye for modern design, clean layouts, mobile responsiveness, and a passion for driving conversions.


What You’ll Do:

  • Design high-converting landing pages, homepages, and product pages for e-commerce brands with a direct-response approach
  • Build clean, responsive layouts with mobile-first optimization
  • Create branded visual assets (banners, product image sections, headers, etc.)
  • Align page structures with CRO best practices and marketing goals
  • Collaborate with our team of developers, strategists, and ad creators
  • Use design tools like Figma, Webflow, Canva, or Replo to produce final files or prototypes for any major platform


Who You Are:

  • You have experience designing web pages for e-commerce or DTC brands (on any platform) with a strong focus on conversion
  • You understand direct response principles and apply them to visual layout and structure
  • You can balance creative design with business outcomes
  • You work well with feedback, iteration, and evolving briefs
  • You understand the value of typography, spacing, color hierarchy, and UX patterns


Tools & Skills Required:

  • Strong proficiency in Figma, Photoshop, or Webflow
  • Portfolio of landing pages or e-commerce websites
  • Clear communication skills in English
  • Bonus: Familiarity with Framer, Replo, or basic HTML/CSS

title: Junior Data Entry - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Junior Data Entry professional will apply foundational skills in data handling to support critical database management processes, focusing on accuracy, efficiency, and continuous skill development in data processing.


Key Responsibilities:


- Performing data entry tasks with high accuracy and efficiency.

- Verifying data by comparing it to source documents and making necessary corrections.

- Maintaining and updating records and databases in accordance with company guidelines.

- Assisting in the organization and storage of data in both digital and physical forms.

- Responding to requests for data retrieval by locating and providing required information.

- Participating in regular training and development sessions to improve data entry skills.


Requirements:


- Experience: 1+ year of data entry

- Data Skills: Good understanding of data organization and storage principles

- Tools: Experience with data entry software and tools

- Performance: Ability to work efficiently and accurately under tight deadlines

- Compliance: Basic knowledge of data privacy and security practices

- Language: Advanced level of English



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Arquiteto de software
description:
A Innvo está em busca de um Arquiteto de Software apaixonado por tecnologia, inovação e boas práticas de engenharia. Se você tem experiência com desenho de arquitetura de sistemas complexos , atua de forma colaborativa e busca criar soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho, venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir para a construção de produtos digitais de ponta.


CLT Full, remoto.


Responsabilidades

Desenhar, documentar e evoluir arquiteturas de software utilizando C4 Model, ADRs ou abordagens similares .

Definir e guiar padrões de arquitetura para sistemas baseados em microserviços e BFF (Backend for Frontend) .

Atuar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e produto para garantir soluções coerentes e sustentáveis.

Apoiar a implementação de soluções baseadas em Java (Quarkus) e Angular , garantindo integração fluida e performance.

Implementar e supervisionar integrações assíncronas com Kafka .

Trabalhar com OpenShift e práticas modernas de DevOps para entrega contínua e escalável.

Garantir que decisões arquiteturais sejam registradas e comunicadas de forma clara e rastreável.

Conduzir revisões técnicas e promover boas práticas de engenharia, performance e segurança.



Requisitos

Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e BFFs .

Domínio em Java (preferencialmente com Quarkus) e Angular .

Experiência com mensageria (Kafka) e arquitetura orientada a eventos.

Prática com OpenShift , Docker e Kubernetes .

Conhecimento em C4 Model , ADRs e documentação arquitetural.

Vivência com CI/CD , APIs RESTful , e API Gateway .

Capacidade de tradução de requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas robustas.

Excelente comunicação e habilidade de trabalho colaborativo com equipes multidisciplinares.



Diferenciais

Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) .

Conhecimento em monitoramento, observabilidade e tracing distribuído .

Participação em comunidades técnicas ou contribuição em projetos open source.



Benefícios

Plano de saúde e odontológico.

Vale-refeição e/ou vale-alimentação.

Seguro de vida.

Gympass / TotalPass.

Parceria com a Fiap e Sesc .

Oportunidades reais de crescimento e desenvolvimento técnico.

title: Informatica PowerCenter Engineer
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Informatica PowerCenter Engineer to join our team on a 6-month remote contract. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in ETL development, data modeling, and integration using Informatica PowerCenter, along with solid SQL and Python skills for data manipulation and analysis.

This role involves working with large-scale data sets, building and maintaining efficient data pipelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable data delivery and quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL workflows using Informatica PowerCenter .
  • Work with data models , data access patterns, and star schemas in data warehouses.
  • Write and optimize advanced SQL queries for data transformation and reporting.
  • Use Python scripting to analyze and manipulate large data sets.
  • Support Managed File Transfer (MFT) integrations and automation.
  • Collaborate on API integrations and AWS S3 data handling.
  • Participate in unit testing, software change management , and release processes .
  • Identify and resolve data quality or performance issues.
  • (Optional) Create and maintain dashboards or visualizations using Tableau .

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Informatica PowerCenter .
  • Strong understanding of data modeling , ETL design, and data warehousing concepts .
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python .
  • Experience with MFT tools and file-based integrations.
  • Working knowledge of APIs and AWS S3 .
  • Familiarity with Tableau or other BI tools is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Join our dynamic Team as a React Developer and drive innovation in a collaborative environment. You'll enhance services, tools, and components within a collaborative Team by driving Agile solutions for internal and external challenges, ensuring top-notch software quality. Become a key player in our Core team, utilizing modern technologies to shape artifacts and support diverse groups, all while ensuring our software reaches new heights of excellence.


Key responsibilities:


- Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable user interface components using React.js.

- Work closely with the product and design teams to achieve effective UX.

- Collaborate with other developers on tasks related to front-end and back-end services.

- Conduct performance optimization of applications for maximum speed and scalability.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the latest React frameworks and libraries.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in React.

- Experience with Typescript.

- Familiarity with caching systems.

- Comfortable working in GMT+2 timezone.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Intermediate English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Projetos (Pl/Sr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Projetos para se unir ao nosso Time de Projects para:

  • Participação de reuniões internas e externas com clientes;
  • Organização das demandas de projetos de acordo o processo definido, com boas práticas do PMBOK e metodologias ágeis;
  • Gerenciamento de solicitações e atividades não previstas em projetos;
  • Realização de atividades operacionais de gestão de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento de contas de projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Acompanhamento de reuniões e atividades de marcos de projetos;
  • Acompanhamento KPIs de projetos;
  • Asseguração da conformidade com padrões e procedimentos internos;
  • Facilitação da comunicação com Stakeholders;
  • Condução de revisões periódicas de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento e planejamento de marcos de faturamento (garantia de receita);
  • Treinamento e suporte à equipe de projetos (exclusivo - Senior)


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação completa em TI ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência de ao menos um ano (Pleno)/ dois anos (Senior) atuando como líder de projetos em contato direto com clientes;
  • Conhecimento sólido em MS Projects, Excel, Cronogramas;
  • Conhecimentos de PMBOK/Scrum/Kanban;
  • Espanhol avançado.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em Jira;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos ou com conceitos relacionados a meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

Work Model: Remote

Contract Type: Contractor



Job Description

We are seeking four experienced Informatica PowerCenter Developers to support a 6-month remote project. Candidates must have strong ETL, data modeling, and analytical expertise, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Informatica PowerCenter (ETL development, workflows, mappings, performance tuning).
  • Strong exposure to Data Modeling and Data Access Patterns .
  • Advanced SQL skills, including writing and optimizing complex queries.
  • Experience with Python scripting for data manipulation and insights across large datasets.
  • Solid experience with MFT (Managed File Transfer) processes.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Experience working with APIs and AWS S3 .
  • Good understanding of unit testing , software change management , and release management .
  • Strong understanding of star schemas and existing data warehouse data models .
  • Good to Have: Knowledge or experience with Tableau .
  • Strong communication skills.

Overview of the Role

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: Senior React Native Mobile Developer
description:
Job Title: Mobile Apps Developer React Native (2 openings) — Advanced to Fluent English required 100% Remote


Role Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Mobile Apps Developer with 10+ years of professional experience , with React Native as the core and mandatory technology . You will lead the development of scalable, high-performance mobile applications and collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver seamless mobile experiences across iOS and Android platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop cross-platform mobile applications using React Native (mandatory) .
  • Optimize, maintain, and refactor React Native codebases for performance and scalability.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs , GraphQL , gRPC , Firebase , and third-party libraries/services.
  • Develop offline-first capabilities and ensure efficient local data persistence.
  • Apply coding best practices, enforce code quality and testing strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with UI/UX teams to convert design prototypes into polished, responsive interfaces.
  • Stay up to date with evolving React Native ecosystem trends, libraries, and tooling.

Required Technical Skills (Mandatory)

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) for communication with international teams.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in mobile application development .
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience developing mobile applications with React Native .
  • Strong understanding of React Native architecture, state management (Redux, Context, Recoil, etc.), navigation, and modular component patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of app performance optimization , memory management , and debugging techniques for mobile apps.
  • Experience with Firebase (analytics, crash reporting, app distribution).
  • Solid knowledge of App Store and Play Store publishing workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Strong proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Solid understanding of mobile security practices , including encryption and secure data storage.

Desired / Nice-to-Have (Not Mandatory)

  • Experience with Flutter development.
  • Experience with native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) .
  • Experience with native Android development (Kotlin/Java) .
  • Prior experience implementing native modules for React Native.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong analytical thinking, ownership, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication skills and proven collaboration across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently or in distributed/remote environments.




Job Title: Senior React JS Web Developer — Advanced to Fluent English Required

Role Description 100% Remote

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior React JS Web Developer with 10+ years of professional experience in modern web development. You will be responsible for designing, building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable and high-performance web applications. This role involves close collaboration with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver seamless, intuitive, and visually engaging user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications using React.js .
  • Optimize codebases for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs , gRPC , GraphQL , Firebase , and third-party services.
  • Implement solutions for efficient state management (Redux, Context API, etc.).
  • Collaborate closely with UI/UX teams to convert design mockups into clean, responsive, accessible interfaces.
  • Apply best practices in testing, code review, and performance optimization.
  • Stay up to date with the latest patterns and evolutions in the React and frontend ecosystem.

Required Technical Skills

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) for collaboration with international teams.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in web application development .
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience with React.js .
  • Strong mastery of React architecture, Hooks, Context API, and reusable component patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of frontend performance optimization , debugging , and memory management .
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) , TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3 , and responsive design.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , version control workflows (Git), pull requests, branching strategies, etc.
  • Solid understanding of web security practices (encryption, secure storage, auth flows, etc.).

Differential (Not Mandatory)

  • Experience with React Native and/or mobile development (Android/iOS).
  • Familiarity with native mobile development (Kotlin/Java or Swift/Objective-C).
  • Experience with App Store / Play Store publishing pipelines (for hybrid app delivery).
  • Firebase for analytics and crash monitoring.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and in distributed teams.

✨ If you are passionate about building elegant and high-impact web experiences, join us at Kaspper and help shape the future!

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop cross-platform mobile applications using React Native (mandatory) .
  • Optimize, maintain, and refactor React Native codebases for performance and scalability.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs , GraphQL , gRPC , Firebase , and third-party libraries/services.
  • Develop offline-first capabilities and ensure efficient local data persistence.
  • Apply coding best practices, enforce code quality and testing strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with UI/UX teams to convert design prototypes into polished, responsive interfaces.
  • Stay up to date with evolving React Native ecosystem trends, libraries, and tooling.

Required Technical Skills (Mandatory)

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) for communication with international teams.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in mobile application development .
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience developing mobile applications with React Native .
  • Strong understanding of React Native architecture, state management (Redux, Context, Recoil, etc.), navigation, and modular component patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of app performance optimization , memory management , and debugging techniques for mobile apps.
  • Experience with Firebase (analytics, crash reporting, app distribution).
  • Solid knowledge of App Store and Play Store publishing workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Strong proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Solid understanding of mobile security practices , including encryption and secure data storage.

Desired / Nice-to-Have (Not Mandatory)

  • Experience with Flutter development.
  • Experience with native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) .
  • Experience with native Android development (Kotlin/Java) .
  • Prior experience implementing native modules for React Native.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong analytical thinking, ownership, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication skills and proven collaboration across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently or in distributed/remote environments.




Job Title: Senior React JS Web Developer — Advanced to Fluent English Required

Role Description 100% Remote

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior React JS Web Developer with 10+ years of professional experience in modern web development. You will be responsible for designing, building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable and high-performance web applications. This role involves close collaboration with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver seamless, intuitive, and visually engaging user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications using React.js .
  • Optimize codebases for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs , gRPC , GraphQL , Firebase , and third-party services.
  • Implement solutions for efficient state management (Redux, Context API, etc.).
  • Collaborate closely with UI/UX teams to convert design mockups into clean, responsive, accessible interfaces.
  • Apply best practices in testing, code review, and performance optimization.
  • Stay up to date with the latest patterns and evolutions in the React and frontend ecosystem.

Required Technical Skills

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) for collaboration with international teams.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in web application development .
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience with React.js .
  • Strong mastery of React architecture, Hooks, Context API, and reusable component patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of frontend performance optimization , debugging , and memory management .
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) , TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3 , and responsive design.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , version control workflows (Git), pull requests, branching strategies, etc.
  • Solid understanding of web security practices (encryption, secure storage, auth flows, etc.).

Differential (Not Mandatory)

  • Experience with React Native and/or mobile development (Android/iOS).
  • Familiarity with native mobile development (Kotlin/Java or Swift/Objective-C).
  • Experience with App Store / Play Store publishing pipelines (for hybrid app delivery).
  • Firebase for analytics and crash monitoring.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and in distributed teams.

✨ If you are passionate about building elegant and high-impact web experiences, join us at Kaspper and help shape the future!

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role


We’re looking for two full-time Virtual Assistants based in Brazil to join our global property management and real estate rental operations team. This is a fast-paced, service-driven role where you’ll communicate directly with guests and tenants across multiple properties, ensuring every experience meets our standard of excellence.


If you’re fluent in English, tech-savvy, and passionate about delivering outstanding customer service — this is a great opportunity to grow in an international environment.


⸻


Key Responsibilities


• Craft clear, professional, and empathetic English responses to guest messages, emails, and inquiries across Airbnb, VRBO and other internal platforms.

• Maintain a 5–10 minute response time to all messages during your shift.

• Deescalate and resolve guest complaints with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.

• Coordinate with cleaning, maintenance, and operations teams to fulfill requests.

• Update and monitor internal systems, CRMs, and property dashboards.

• Document all customer interactions accurately for team follow-up and quality control.

• Collaborate with team members to ensure seamless daily operations.


⸻


Requirements


• Fluent in English (spoken and written) – excellent grammar and communication tone.

• Strong typing skills (80+ WPM) and confidence navigating multiple platforms.

• High attention to detail, accountability, and ability to multitask under pressure.

• Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.

• Must have a reliable laptop/computer and high-speed WiFi.

• Previous experience with Airbnb, property management, or hospitality support is a plus but not required.

• Professional, positive, and culturally aligned with a high standard of service.


⸻


Why Join Us


• Work 100% remotely from anywhere in Brazil.

• Full-time, consistent hours (40 hours/week).

• Competitive hourly rate in USD.

• Supportive, fast-growing international team.

• Career growth opportunities for high-performing team members.


⸻


If you’re ready to join a professional, global team that values reliability, communication, and excellence — we’d love to meet you.

title: Consultor SAP MM/WM
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Líder Técnico III - Visão Computacional
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de Inteligência Artificial, com foco em Visão Computacional, no Inatel Competence Center - PDI SW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir a estratégia técnica do projeto, desenvolver e comunicando uma visão clara e estratégica para a aplicação de Inteligência Artificial, Visão Computacional e Data Science na Instituição;
  • Orientar desenvolvimento de Modelos Avançados, supervisionando a equipe na criação de modelos estatísticos e de aprendizado de máquina utilizando técnicas avançadas e modernas;
  • Aplicar e conceber arquitetura de soluções inovadoras para plataformas Network as a Service (NaaS) com foco em integração de técnicas de IA e ML;
  • Realizar estudos aprofundados e análises de estruturas, dados, plataformas e ferramentas de IA/ML, fornecendo insights valiosos para tomada de decisões;
  • Preparar documentações estratégica e técnica abrangente sobre as soluções propostas e adotadas, garantindo a compreensão e rastreabilidade dos projetos;
  • Liderar o Time de QA, provendo orientação e suporte ao time de Garantia da Qualidade para garantir a confiabilidade e robustez das soluções implementadas;
  • Executar revisão técnica proativa, examinar o código desenvolvido e assegurar que ele esteja em conformidade com as melhores práticas da tecnologia e promovendo a melhoria contínua;
  • Atuar como Multiplicador de Conhecimento, oferecendo suporte técnico e mentorship aos colegas, promovendo o desenvolvimento da equipe.


Requisitos e qualificações


Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiência em:

  • Linguagem de programação Python ou Go,
  • Métodos estatísticos para análise de dados,
  • Desenvolvimento de algoritmos de Machine Learning/Deep Learning,
  • Arquitetura em microserviços,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas,
  • Banco de dados de alto volume (relacional, não relacional, data lake ou data warehouse);


Conhecimentos em:

  • Conhecimento em Keras, PyTorch e TensorFlow,
  • MLOps,
  • Plataformas Cloud (AWS ou Azure),
  • CI/CD,
  • Melhores práticas de desenvolvimento,
  • Metodologias ágeis.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em soluções SDN;
  • Prática em projetos com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimentos em: Big Data, Data Science, gRPC, banco de dados temporal e mock de dados;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e escrita e intermediário para conversação.


Informações adicionais

Horário das atividades: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.


Local das atividades: As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de teletrabalho "home office".
